sections.name: StampKind, TEXT
sections.title: Stamp kinds and their words
sections.what: Lists the five allowed stamp kinds and the English word shown for each.
sections.why: Likely reason: a fixed list keeps stamps consistent across the app.

sections.name: Stamp
sections.title: Stamp display
sections.what: Shows the word with a style chosen by kind, plus an accessible label. The drop-in animation runs only when animate is set.
sections.why: Reason for the animate option not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Users who ask for reduced motion see the stamp without the movement.

summary: A tilted rubber-stamp label marking a call as locked, graded, classified, revealed or a coin flip.
purpose: Gives a quick visual status on a call.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the stamp styling.
how: Looks up the words for the kind, draws them, and sets an accessible label. The drop-in animation runs only when animate is set.
inputs: kind (one of five stamp kinds) and animate (optional yes or no).
risks: A new kind added to the type without an entry in the word table shows nothing.
debug: If a stamp is blank, check the kind name against both the type and the word table.
